title: WebDesk Growth Dashboard — Webhook Event
description: Formalizes inbound webhook records (GitHub, and WordPress if/when confirmed) per nodejs/knowledge/security/04-webhook-security.md's three-control model applied via knowledge/06-github-app-integration.md and knowledge/07-wordpress-integration.md. Unique index on (provider, event_id) enforces replay-dedupe at the database level, not only in application code.

event_id.description: Provider's own delivery/event ID (e.g. GitHub's X-GitHub-Delivery header value). Unique per (provider, event_id) — a repeat is acknowledged but not re-processed.

payload_checksum.description: SHA-256 of the raw payload body, recorded for audit/debugging without necessarily retaining the full payload long-term.

signature_verified.description: Must be true for the event to reach 'processing'. An event failing signature verification is recorded with signature_verified=false and status='rejected', never processed.

signature_algorithm.description: e.g. 'hmac-sha256'. Recorded for audit even though verification already happened by the time this row is written.

related_job_id.description: The background job (per job-record.schema.json) that performs the actual processing, once the webhook is acked and enqueued (ack-fast-process-async pattern).
